verdict.rationale: Lindy is operated mainly through natural-language delegation. You hand it email, meeting and scheduling work in Slack DMs, delegate over iMessage/SMS, describe a process once so it becomes a reusable skill, and prompt daily briefs by telling it what you want. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor docs), and some account and settings controls use structured /lindy slash commands rather than free-form language.
